speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
text: asked	the Prime Minister what additional measures are being taken to enhance anti-money laundering compliance by financial institutions in the wake of the withdrawal of BSI's merchant banking licence.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Indeed, all international financial and business centres face the risk of being used as a conduit for money laundering and terrorist financing activities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Singapore has taken this risk very seriously and we have in recent years significantly enhanced our regime for tackling money laundering and illicit financing risks.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Financial institutions are the critical gatekeepers against the flow of illicit funds.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: So, we require financial institutions to comply with strict anti-money laundering regulations and to have in place robust controls to detect and deter illicit activities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Our regulatory and law enforcement agencies also share information and cooperate closely with their foreign counterparts.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: It is heartening to know that we have a robust suite of measures.

speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: But I would like to ask the Minister how he intends to mitigate the higher operating costs for financial institutions to comply with these enhanced anti-money laundering measures in order to help them stay competitive globally.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: And, indeed, the higher cost will be a cause for concern with regard to competition if our banks were to do it alone whereas other banks elsewhere do not have to comply with these same requirements.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: But the reality is that these new requirements are imposed across the board.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: So, I think this is an increased cost but it is a cost that financial institutions would have to bear in order to be more effective in the global fight against money laundering and against terrorism financing.
